Bind an absolute native executable

Usage: larp cc provider bind [OPTIONS] <PROVIDER> <EXECUTABLE>

Arguments:
  <PROVIDER>    [possible values: claude, codex]
  <EXECUTABLE>  

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --replace                                Replace an existing provider binding
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
